import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, bottom, length, ne;
        public Edge(int to, int bottom, int length, int ne) {
            this.to = to;
            this.bottom = bottom;
            this.length = length;
            this.ne = ne;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 55;
    static final int MAXT = 2 * MAXN;
    static final int MAXP = MAXT * MAXN;
    static final int MAXE = 5 * MAXT * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;

    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static int readInt() throws IOException {
        while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        }
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    static char read_char() throws IOException {
        return (char) br.read();
    }

    static int[] cnt = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] node_id = new int[MAXN][MAXT];
    static ArrayList<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head = new int[MAXP];
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[MAXP];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXP];

    static int N, M, K, C, D, S = 1, E, pt = 2;
    static int total_cost = 0;

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        edges.add(new Edge(b, l, c, head[a]));
        head[a] = edges.size() - 1;
    }

    static void add_bi_edge(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        add_edge(a, b, c, l);
        add_edge(b, a, -c, 0);
    }

    static boolean spfa_algorithm() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        dist[S] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(S);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int p = q.poll();
            in_queue[p] = false;
            for (int i = head[p]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).ne) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                if (e.bottom == 0) continue;
                int b = e.to;
                if (dist[b] > dist[p] + e.length) {
                    dist[b] = dist[p] + e.length;
                    if (!in_queue[b]) {
                        q.offer(b);
                        in_queue[b] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[E] < INF;
    }

    static int max_flow_value(int x, int flow) {
        if (x == S) return flow;
        in_queue[x] = true;
        int remaining = flow;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).ne) {
            Edge e = edges.get(i);
            int b = e.to;
            if (in_queue[b] || e.bottom == 0 || dist[x] < dist[b] + edges.get(i ^ 1).length) continue;
            int pushed = max_flow_value(b, Math.min(remaining, e.bottom));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.bottom -= pushed;
                edges.get(i ^ 1).bottom += pushed;
                remaining -= pushed;
                if (remaining == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return flow - remaining;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        N = readInt();
        M = readInt();
        K = readInt();
        C = readInt();
        D = readInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            cnt[i] = readInt();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 2; j++) {
                node_id[i][j] = ++pt;
                if (i == 1) {
                    add_edge(node_id[i][j], E, C * (j - 1), INF);
                }
                if (j > 1) {
                    add_edge(node_id[i][j - 1], node_id[i][j], 0, INF);
                }
            }
            if (cnt[i] > 0) {
                add_edge(S, node_id[i][1], 0, cnt[i]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
            int a = readInt();
            int b = readInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= 2 * K - 1; k += 2) {
                    add_edge(node_id[a][j], node_id[b][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                    add_edge(node_id[b][j], node_id[a][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                }
            }
        }

        int total_flow = 0;
        while (spfa_algorithm()) {
            int flow_value;
            do {
                Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
                flow_value = max_flow_value(E, INF);
                if (flow_value > 0) {
                    total_flow += flow_value;
                    total_cost += dist[E] * flow_value;
                }
            } while (flow_value > 0);
        }

        System.out.println(total_cost);
    }
}
